HOW YOU’LL BUILD

Technical depth.
Two execution paths.

Code +

For engineers, data scientists and technical founders. Build full-stack systems, APIs, retrieval pipelines and agents with code.

Low-code +

For builders who want to work through visual tools. Connect interfaces, APIs and databases with tools such as n8n and Supabase. You still learn the underlying system.

Either execution path can support either goal track. Placement is informed by your goals, capacity and early building activity.

BEFORE YOU DECIDETHE PRACTICAL QUESTIONS

A few things
worth knowing.

Clarity before commitment.

↗Ask the 100x team
When does the next cohort start?+

The official 100xEngineers website lists Cohort 9 as starting 4 December 2026. Confirm availability, exact class timings and any changes with admissions. The weekly sequence here follows the detailed Cohort 9 curriculum.

What happens immediately after I pay?+

The pre-cohort sequence is the 72-hour Build Challenge, then LaunchPad intake, then kickoff. Follow the team’s instructions for access to Discord, the learning management system and submission deadlines. If you haven’t received them, contact admissions with your payment confirmation.

Do I need to know how to code?+

There are code and low-code execution paths. Low-code lets you build through visual tools and integrations, while still learning APIs, databases and system design. Discuss your starting level with the team to find your fit.

How much time should I set aside?+

The brochure’s schedule recommends 8–12 hours per week across 24 weeks. Protect time for building as well as live classes. Weekly roadmaps offer two goal levels so you can choose a realistic pace.

What if I fall behind?+

Use office hours, your buddy and the cohort’s check-ins to raise blockers early. Week 19 is a dedicated catch-up and breather week. Ask the team how to prioritise if you need to adjust your pace.

Is the final project finished by week 24?+

The detailed curriculum says week 24 begins the final capstone sprint, including planning and mentor matching. Ask the team for the final sprint’s submission and review schedule.

What continues after six months?+

The brochure includes lifetime community access and recordings and updates from the next two cohorts. Confirm the duration and scope of any individual career, incubation or mentoring support with the team.
